paragraphs: R. Mana of She'av, in R. Yehoshua ben Levi's name, Elu Kesharim—I did not find it there. R. Yehoshua of Sikhnin in R. Levi's name, Tanḥuma, Tetzavveh and Aḥarei Mot.
